newsitem.title: UK: Ekofisk Sept loadings delayed due to lower output.
newsitem.headline: Ekofisk Sept loadings delayed due to lower output.

text.p: Some loadings of Norwegian Ekofisk crude oil in September have been delayed by a day due to lower than expected production, trading sources said.
"The Ekofisk programme has been deferred by a day for cargoes loading September 10-17," said a trader familiar with the system's operations.
Equity holders were informed of the delay by telex on Wednesday, which was caused by lower than expected production at the main Ekofisk field, the trader said.
No cargoes have been cancelled, he added.
The Ekofisk crude oil pipeline system, operated by Phillips Petroleum, is to due to load 14.4 million barrels in September, down 400,000 barrels from August, traders said earlier this month.
The original September programme envisaged 17 cargoes of 500,000 barrels, eight of 600,000 and one each of 550,000 and 570,000 barrels.
